nodes.label: Machine & Work Order Linking
nodes.rationale: Tracks which parts were used on which machines/tickets for cost allocation and audit trail.

nodes.label: Proper Logging System (HIGH-1)
nodes.rationale: Print statements give no audit trail or log rotation.

nodes.label: MachineIssue date_time auto_now Fix
nodes.rationale: auto_now=True overwrote creation timestamp on every save, breaking downtime/SLA calculations; switched to auto_now_add plus a separate last_updated field (migration 0007).

nodes.label: Engineer Workflow Enhancements (doc filters, duplicate review fix)
nodes.norm_label: engineer workflow enhancements (doc filters, duplicate review fix)

nodes.label: Missing select_related() on ComplainTrackingView
nodes.rationale: Template needed user, equipment, machine_id, error_department and machineissue__reviewer relations; loading them in one query fixed blank pages and improved performance.

nodes.label: Layered Security (UI / Backend / Permissions)
nodes.rationale: Hiding sidebar links is UX only; backend decorator/dispatch checks prevent URL-manipulation bypass; @permission_required still applies.

nodes.label: Role-Based Inventory Access (full vs view-only)
nodes.rationale: Inventory Controller gets view/add/change/delete spares; Engineering and Management get view_spares + view_sparetransaction only. Enforced in templates (perms.core.*) and views (@permission_required -> 403).

nodes.label: Defense in Depth (view/template/API permission checks)
nodes.rationale: Granular per-model permissions (Spares, Machines, Unit, Employee, Equipment, Department) enforced at view, template and AJAX API levels.

nodes.label: Fixture load order (Department, Contractor, Designation, Manufacturer, Equipment, Machines, Spares, IssueList)
nodes.norm_label: fixture load order (department, contractor, designation, manufacturer, equipment, machines, spares, issuelist)

nodes.label: Full Inventory CSV Export
nodes.rationale: One-click, timestamped CSV (inventory_export_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv) so previous exports are never overwritten; for monthly reports, low-stock and cost analysis.

nodes.label: Transaction History CSV Export
nodes.rationale: Per-item ledger export with header and per-type summary section for audit trails and compliance.

nodes.label: Spares.location AttributeError
nodes.rationale: Export accessed a non-existent location field; replaced with the real date_of_purchase field (19 columns).

nodes.label: Filter by Machine dropdown
nodes.rationale: Client-side filtering over data-machines attributes for instant results with no server load.

nodes.label: Machine-Spare Many-to-Many (machine_spare / related_name machines)
nodes.rationale: Optional (blank=True) so existing spares need no data migration and appear as general purpose.

nodes.label: Staged Unique Constraint Migration
nodes.rationale: Existing duplicate item_code values ('-') block a unique constraint; add fields without it, backfill via fix_spare_item_codes, then add unique=True to avoid IntegrityError.

nodes.label: Spare Transaction Ledger
nodes.rationale: Every add/receive/issue/edit quantity change logged for full audit trail.

nodes.label: Engineer Quick Review (Triage)
nodes.rationale: Quick review only changes status and no longer auto-creates a MachineIssueReview with dummy data, separating quick triage from formal documentation.

nodes.label: Resolution Status Field in Review Form
nodes.norm_label: resolution status field in review form

nodes.label: User Acknowledgment of Resolution
nodes.rationale: Complaint creator must confirm a RESOLVED issue is actually fixed before engineer can close; rejection returns it for rework.

nodes.label: Minimal MachineIssueReview Auto-Creation
nodes.rationale: Quick-resolution path skipped full review, so ComplainClosingView crashed; auto-creating a minimal review keeps referential integrity while real documentation goes in IssueClosing.

nodes.label: Review Required Before Closing Rule
nodes.rationale: All closures need formal documentation for audit/compliance; enforced at model level (validate_status_transition) and view level (ComplainClosingView.get).

nodes.label: Automatic Smart Redirects (closing <-> review)
nodes.rationale: Instead of erroring when no MachineIssueReview exists, ComplainClosingView redirects to the review form, and the review post redirects back to closing, guiding engineers without manual navigation.

nodes.label: Client-Side Ticket Filtering
nodes.rationale: All tickets passed in template context; status/date/search filtering in vanilla JS gives instant results without server roundtrips.

nodes.label: 3-Column Ticket Management View
nodes.rationale: Filters/list/detail panes with AJAX detail loading avoid page reloads and lost scroll position when scanning tickets.

nodes.label: Role-Based Ticket Filtering (Approvers/Engineers/Users)
nodes.rationale: Reduces clutter and enforces responsibilities: approvers see REVIEWED/APPROVED/REJECTED, engineers see PENDING/APPROVED/AWAITING_DOCUMENTATION/RESOLVED/UNDER_OBSERVATION, users see own tickets; Approver > Engineer > Regular precedence.

nodes.label: Ticket Filtering System by User Role
nodes.norm_label: ticket filtering system by user role

nodes.label: Live Duplicate Detection for Spares
nodes.rationale: Prevents duplicate purchases/entries by debounced checks on name and manufacturer part number.

nodes.label: Quick Fix: 500 Error When Issuing Items
nodes.norm_label: quick fix: 500 error when issuing items

nodes.label: Fetch-Populate-Then-Open Modal Pattern
nodes.rationale: data-bs-toggle opened the modal before async fetch set form.action, so submits POSTed to /home/spares and returned 500; modal is now opened programmatically only after data loads and action URL is set.

nodes.label: Inventory Controller Access Restriction
nodes.rationale: Inventory Controllers may only reach /home/spares; enforced via UI sidebar, User/decorators.py view redirects, and Django permissions (three security layers).

nodes.label: Inventory Permission Tiers (Controller full, Engineering/Management view-only)
nodes.norm_label: inventory permission tiers (controller full, engineering/management view-only)

nodes.label: Tiered Access Control (All Users/Engineering/Management)
nodes.rationale: Principle of least privilege and defense in depth via view dispatch checks, template has_perm checks and group permissions.

nodes.label: Engineer/Approver Role Access Control
nodes.rationale: Access via 'Engineers'/'Approvers' groups or core.can_review_complaint / core.can_approve_complaint permissions.

nodes.label: auto_now vs auto_now_add on MachineIssue.date_time
nodes.rationale: auto_now overwrote creation time on every save, corrupting downtime calculations; switched to auto_now_add via migration 0007_fix_date_time_field.

nodes.label: Edit Inventory Item Modal
nodes.rationale: Item code and category are read-only because the code is auto-generated from category; quantity changes are logged as transactions for audit.

nodes.label: Import Duplicate Handling (--skip-duplicates)
nodes.rationale: Duplicates detected by manufacturer part number or exact name; default updates with ADJUSTMENT transaction, flag skips.

nodes.label: Manufacturer Standardization
nodes.rationale: Manufacturer FK + official part number avoids differing spellings for the same part.

nodes.label: Auto-Generated Item Codes (ELE/MEC/HYD/PNE/SAF/GEN-####)
nodes.rationale: Users entering random codes caused inconsistency; codes generated in Spares.save() from category prefix with sequential numbering, unique and non-editable.

nodes.label: Closing form (spares, contractor, POST to User:complain_closing)
nodes.norm_label: closing form (spares, contractor, post to user:complain_closing)

nodes.label: Complaint Lifecycle timeline (Raised -> Engineer Review -> Resolved/Observation/Awaiting Docs -> HOD Approval -> Closure)
nodes.norm_label: complaint lifecycle timeline (raised -> engineer review -> resolved/observation/awaiting docs -> hod approval -> closure)

nodes.label: User feedback bottom-sheet form (Confirm Resolution / Report Still Broken)
nodes.norm_label: user feedback bottom-sheet form (confirm resolution / report still broken)

nodes.label: Work Activity sessions card (engineer sessions, live timers)
nodes.norm_label: work activity sessions card (engineer sessions, live timers)

nodes.label: Complaint form dynamic API lookups (machine-code, issuelist, machine-hours, machine-section)
nodes.norm_label: complaint form dynamic api lookups (machine-code, issuelist, machine-hours, machine-section)

nodes.label: Department CASCADE Delete Issue
nodes.rationale: Department FK uses on_delete=CASCADE so delete+recreate of a department deletes Employees; prefer renaming/updating or using Django admin.

nodes.label: Employee-User Account Link
nodes.rationale: Views now catch Employee.DoesNotExist and show warnings instead of crashing when a user has no linked Employee record.

nodes.label: Issue status values (PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, User Feedback, RESOLVED, AWAITING_DOCUMENTATION, UNDER_OBSERVATION, REVIEWED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CLOSED)
nodes.norm_label: issue status values (pending, in_progress, user feedback, resolved, awaiting_documentation, under_observation, reviewed, approved, rejected, closed)

nodes.label: nginx service (reverse proxy)
nodes.rationale: Recommended for production: serves static/media and proxies to Django; HTTPS via Let's Encrypt.

nodes.label: web service (Django + Gunicorn)
nodes.rationale: 4 Gunicorn workers, auto-migrates and collects static on startup via entrypoint.sh.

nodes.label: Spare Transaction Ledger (audit trail)
nodes.rationale: Every stock movement logged with who/when/why/before/after for compliance (ISO 9001, financial audit).

nodes.label: Stock Receiving and Transaction Ledger Doc
nodes.norm_label: stock receiving and transaction ledger doc

nodes.label: Backend UTC to Asia/Karachi Conversion (pytz)
nodes.rationale: API returned naive UTC strings so UI showed times 5 hours behind; backend now converts with astimezone(Asia/Karachi) and JS parses the string as local.

nodes.label: Frontend Intl timeZone Asia/Karachi Formatting
nodes.rationale: Store UTC in DB (USE_TZ=True, TIME_ZONE=Asia/Karachi) and convert at display time using browser Intl API.

nodes.label: Ticket Status Progression (RESOLVED -> AWAITING_DOCUMENTATION -> CLOSED)
nodes.rationale: Model validate_status_transition prevents CLOSED without review; user must acknowledge RESOLVED before engineer documents.

nodes.label: /api/ticket-detail/<pk>/ endpoint
nodes.rationale: 500 errors caused by select_related() on reverse OneToOne (machineissue, issue_remarks), unsafe attribute access and missing null checks; fixed with safe access and better error reporting.

nodes.label: Complete Documentation Button
nodes.rationale: Context-aware one-click access to the closing form for engineers on AWAITING_DOCUMENTATION tickets, reducing documentation delays.

nodes.label: Ticket Status Filter Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Pure frontend filtering with live count badges; no server requests needed.

nodes.label: Closing Form Redirect Fix
nodes.rationale: Redirect to maintenance:complain_list instead of User:complain_closing_list so engineers continue processing their queue.

nodes.label: Resolution Status Field (Still Working / Resolved)
nodes.rationale: 'Still Working' is default as the safe choice; engineer marking RESOLVED requires user confirmation before documentation.

nodes.label: Double Filtering Bug (template + view)
nodes.rationale: Template re-filtered tickets by department after role-based view filtering, hiding tickets from approvers/engineers; filtering moved to view level only.

nodes.label: Update-or-Create Review Pattern
nodes.rationale: MachineIssueReview has a unique constraint on issue_id; re-reviewing UNDER_OBSERVATION/REJECTED tickets must update the existing review instead of creating a duplicate. Malfunction parts are cleared then re-added; images are additive.

nodes.label: Secure API Endpoints (CRITICAL-6)
nodes.rationale: MachineIssueCreateAPIView and IssueListAPIView use AllowAny permission.

nodes.label: File Upload Validation (core/validators.py) (CRITICAL-5)
nodes.rationale: Uploads in ComplainClosingView, ComplainReviewView and TemporaryIssueReviewView are unvalidated; propose validate_image_file/validate_files_list with size, extension and PIL verify checks.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Secrets Vulnerability (CRITICAL-1)
nodes.rationale: SECRET_KEY, JWT key and DB password in settings.py allow forging sessions/JWTs; move to env vars via dotenv.

nodes.label: Operational Hardening (pooling, health checks, backups, monitoring)
nodes.norm_label: operational hardening (pooling, health checks, backups, monitoring)

nodes.label: Phased Remediation Plan (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 and 2 (~2 weeks) are the minimum viable production bar; MEDIUM (rate limiting, input sanitization, tests) and LOW (Redis caching, API docs) follow.
